abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。
title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治

abstract: A coarse certification provides simple but incomplete information. Its rationale is to help consumers trade off dimensions of quality that are complex and lack salience. In imperfectly competitive markets, it may induce excess bunching at the certification requirement, crowd out quality, and facilitate price discrimination. Who will ultimately benefit from a coarse certification thus depends on the degree of market power firms can exercise as well as on consumers' sophistication in responding to such information. I use a structural econometric model of the U.S. appliance market to illustrate these insights using the ENERGY STAR certification as a case study.
abstract_zh: 粗放型认证提供简单但不完整的信息。其基本原理是帮助消费者权衡复杂且缺乏显著性的质量维度。在不完全竞争市场中，这种认证可能导致企业在认证要求处过度聚集、挤占质量提升空间，并促进价格歧视。因此，粗放型认证的最终受益者取决于企业能够行使的市场势力程度，以及消费者对此类信息的反应成熟度。本文以能源之星认证为案例，运用美国家电市场的结构计量经济学模型来阐释上述见解。
title: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
title_zh: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。

abstract: Abstract China's overseas patents grew rapidly in the past two decades at the same time as China became the world's largest exporter of merchandise goods. This paper investigates the effects of overseas patents on the volume and prices of Chinese firms' exports. We consider two channels. First, patents prevent imitation and rival entry, leading to higher quantities and prices. Second, patents reduce the likelihood of litigation and can allow firms to price more aggressively if they are keeping prices high to deter potential litigation in the export market. We find evidence of both. Both channels predict a higher quantity of exports, and we find evidence of that in the data. We also compile evidence consistent with patents allowing Chinese firms to price more aggressively (lower prices).
abstract_zh: 摘要 过去二十年，中国海外专利数量快速增长，与此同时，中国成为全球最大的商品出口国。本文研究海外专利对中国企业出口规模与价格的影响。我们考虑两种作用机制：其一，专利阻止模仿与竞争者进入，从而提升出口数量与价格；其二，专利降低诉讼风险，若企业为规避出口市场潜在诉讼而维持高价，则专利可使其采取更激进的定价策略。实证结果支持两种机制的存在。两种机制均预测出口数量增加，数据验证了这一结论。此外，我们发现的证据表明，专利使中国企业能够采取更激进的定价策略（即降低价格）。

title: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters

abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们记录到，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治联盟。由于地缘政治联盟国家面临更同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为解释这些模式，我们将地缘政治因素引入有限承诺的主权借款模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款转向盟国，并削弱风险分担。
title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

abstract: We introduce When Alpha Disappears, a paired evaluation benchmark for diagnosing decision-time leakage in financial machine-learning backtests. Rather than treating leakage as a binary property, the benchmark estimates protocol-induced inflation by toggling one evaluation convention at a time around a clean $t{+}1$-open reference, while holding the data panel, walk-forward split, model family, horizon, portfolio rule, and cost convention fixed. Across two daily-OHLCV equity panels, six model families, and yearly tests from 2016--2024, we find that inflation is highly selective: centered temporal features and same-day-open execution with post-open daily-bar information cause large and stable increases in both predictive and trading metrics, whereas global normalization, future-informed graph structure, and same-day-close execution are weak in most settings. The benchmark is diagnostic rather than a claim of tradable alpha, and is intended to make evaluation assumptions, failure modes, and protocol fragility directly measurable.
abstract_zh: 我们提出“当阿尔法消失时”这一配对评估基准，用于诊断金融机器学习回测中的决策时点信息泄露。该基准并非将信息泄露视为二元属性，而是通过围绕一个干净的t+1开盘参考点，每次切换一项评估惯例，同时固定数据面板、滚动窗口划分、模型家族、预测周期、投资组合规则及成本惯例，来估计协议引发的通胀效应。基于两个日频OHLCV股票面板、六个模型家族以及2016至2024年的年度测试，我们发现通胀具有高度选择性：中心化时序特征、同日开盘执行结合开盘后日频柱信息，会导致预测指标和交易指标均出现显著且稳定的提升；而全局归一化、基于未来信息的图结构以及同日收盘执行在大多数设定下影响较弱。该基准旨在进行诊断，而非声称存在可交易的阿尔法，其目的是使评估假设、失效模式及协议脆弱性变得可直接度量。
title: When Alpha Disappears: A One-Switch Benchmark for Decision-Time Leakage in Financial Backtests
title_zh: 当阿尔法消失时：金融回测中决策时点泄露的单次切换基准

abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic dynamics of climate policy in a multi-sector dynamic general equilibrium model with renewable and non-renewable energy, sector-specific capital adjustment frictions, household energy demand, and endogenous fossil resource dynamics. The central mechanism is that decarbonization requires reallocating energy use and installed capital: fossil energy demand can contract immediately, while renewable capacity and abatement adjust only gradually. The analysis delivers four results. First, gradual policy implementation sharply reduces transition costs: relative to immediate implementation, gradual emissions caps improve welfare by 2.26 percentage points under comprehensive regulation and by 5.06 percentage points under firm-only regulation. Second, renewable energy subsidies and non-renewable energy taxes support renewable capital accumulation and reduce, but do not eliminate, the welfare cost of front-loaded tightening. Third, sectoral coverage changes the welfare ranking across implementation speeds. Firm-only regulation performs better under gradual implementation because it shields utility-relevant household energy services, but becomes nearly as costly as the carbon-price-only transition under immediate implementation. Fourth, endogenous fossil exploration and stock-dependent extraction costs transmit climate policy into lower extraction, fewer discoveries, and a declining shadow value of reserves, providing a structural mechanism for stranded fossil assets. The results show that deep decarbonization can be achieved at substantially lower macroeconomic cost when policy manages the speed and incidence of energy-capital reallocation.
abstract_zh: 本文在多部门动态一般均衡模型中研究气候政策的宏观经济动态，该模型包含可再生能源与不可再生能源、部门特定的资本调整摩擦、家庭能源需求以及内生的化石资源动态。核心机制在于：脱碳需要重新配置能源使用和已安装资本——化石能源需求可立即收缩，而可再生能源产能与减排措施仅能逐步调整。分析得出四项结论。第一，渐进式政策实施能显著降低转型成本：相较于立即实施，在全面监管下渐进式排放上限可使福利提升2.26个百分点，在企业单独监管下则提升5.06个百分点。第二，可再生能源补贴与不可再生能源税有助于促进可再生能源资本积累，并降低（但无法消除）前置收紧带来的福利成本。第三，部门覆盖范围会改变不同实施速度下的福利排序。渐进式实施中企业单独监管表现更优，因其保护了与效用相关的家庭能源服务，但在立即实施下其成本几乎与仅依赖碳价格的转型相当。第四，内生的化石能源勘探与储量依赖型开采成本使气候政策传导为开采量下降、发现量减少及储量影子价值降低，为化石资产搁浅提供了结构性机制。研究结果表明，当政策能够管理能源-资本重新配置的速度与影响范围时，深度脱碳可在显著降低宏观经济成本的条件下实现。
title: Climate Policy and The Energy Transition
title_zh: 气候政策与能源转型

abstract: This paper complements and extends Doldi, Frittelli and Maggis, Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality, Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025), by studying collective pricing and hedging when admissible risk exchanges form a finitely generated convex cone. The collective First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing and the collective pricing-hedging duality are extended to this setting. A key contribution is a closedness result showing that no collective arbitrage implies the closedness of the aggregate feasibility cone combining infinite-dimensional trading opportunities with finite-dimensional exchanges. The paper also proves that no-collective-arbitrage prices for vectors of contingent claims form a relatively open convex set. Finally, strong collective replicability is introduced and shown to be equivalent to price uniqueness. This leads to an enhanced collective Second Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing, providing equivalent characterizations of collective completeness and strong collective completeness in terms of the uniqueness of the collective equivalent martingale measure. We highlight that several core aspects of the theory are substantially altered when exchanges belong to a convex cone rather than a vector space.
abstract_zh: 本文对Doldi、Frittelli与Maggis的《集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶》（Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025)）进行了补充与拓展，研究了当可接受风险交换构成有限生成凸锥时的集体定价与对冲问题。本文将集体资产定价第一基本定理及集体定价-对冲对偶推广至该设定。核心贡献在于一项闭性结论：无集体套利意味着聚合可行性锥的闭性，该锥结合了无限维交易机会与有限维交换。本文还证明了无集体套利条件下未定权益向量的价格构成相对开凸集。最后，本文引入强集体可复制性概念，并证明其等价于价格唯一性。由此推导出增强的集体资产定价第二基本定理，以集体等价鞅测度的唯一性为条件，给出了集体完备性与强集体完备性的等价刻画。我们强调，当交换属于凸锥而非向量空间时，该理论的若干核心方面会发生实质性改变。
title: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II
title_zh: 集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶性 II

abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic drivers of corporate investment in the United Kingdom using a multivariate time-series framework. Focusing on five key variables-interest rates, inflation, GDP growth, exchange rates, and corporate profits-the analysis investigates their combined effects on aggregate corporate investment using annual data from 1990 to 2022. By concentrating on macroeconomic determinants rather than firm-level factors, the study provides evidence on how monetary and real-sector conditions shape investment behavior in a mature, market-based economy. The contribution of this study lies in integrating long-run macroeconomic trends within a multivariate econometric framework that captures interactions between corporate profits, inflation, and exchange-rate movements in the UK over three decades of evolving policy regimes. Given the mixed order of integration among the variables, the study employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach to examine long-run relationships and short-run adjustment dynamics. OLS and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates are retained as benchmark and robustness checks. The results indicate that higher interest rates exert a significant positive effect on corporate investment, consistent with the endogenous and pro-cyclical nature of UK monetary policy. Corporate profits have a strong positive influence, highlighting the importance of internal finance. Inflation exhibits a negative and significant impact, while GDP growth shows a weak accelerator effect and exchange-rate movements are statistically insignificant. These findings underscore the dominance of profitability and policy credibility in driving UK investment and offer relevant insights for sustaining long-term capital formation.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用多元时间序列框架，考察英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素。聚焦利率、通胀、GDP增长、汇率及企业利润五大关键变量，基于1990年至2022年的年度数据，分析其对总体企业投资的综合影响。通过聚焦宏观层面而非企业层面的决定因素，本研究揭示了货币与实体部门条件如何塑造成熟市场经济体的投资行为。本研究的贡献在于，将长期宏观经济趋势整合至多元计量框架中，捕捉英国三十年间政策体制演变下企业利润、通胀与汇率波动之间的交互作用。鉴于变量间存在混合阶数整合特征，研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法，考察长期关系与短期调整动态。同时保留普通最小二乘法（OLS）与两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果，作为基准检验与稳健性验证。结果表明：利率上升对企业投资具有显著正向效应，这与英国货币政策的内生性与顺周期性特征一致；企业利润呈现强正向影响，凸显内部融资的重要性；通胀具有显著负向影响，而GDP增长仅呈现微弱加速效应，汇率波动则无统计显著性。这些发现强调了盈利能力与政策可信度对英国投资的主导作用，为维持长期资本形成提供了相关启示。
title: Macroeconomic Drivers of Corporate Investment in the United Kingdom: A Multivariate Analysis
title_zh: 英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素：一项多元分析

abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Although meteorological skill has improved substantially in recent years—driven by steady advances in physics-based models and impressive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence-based forecasting—operational evaluations still focus primarily on standard skill metrics, with limited consideration of how improvements in meteorological skill translate into economic value. This study proposes a flexible framework to assess the economic value of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses as well as declining user trust in cases of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost—loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. The framework is applied to cities exposed to weather-related natural hazards, comparing the relative economic value of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs, which often substantially alter conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based Integrated Forecast System high-resolution model (IFS HRES) makes it better suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating economic value under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 评估天气预报的真实经济价值仍具挑战性，尤其是在高影响极端事件的背景下。尽管近年来气象预报技能显著提升——得益于基于物理模型的稳步改进和基于人工智能预报的突破性进展——但业务评估仍主要聚焦于标准技能指标，对气象技能提升如何转化为经济价值的考量十分有限。本研究提出一个灵活框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，其惩罚函数明确考虑了复合损失以及重复误报情况下用户信任度下降的影响。此外，该框架允许成本-损失比变化，以表征异质性预防成本和脆弱性结构。将该框架应用于面临天气相关自然灾害的城市，比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心领先的基于物理模型和数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和预防成本的假设高度敏感，这些因素往往显著改变仅基于气象技能得出的结论。例如，在南欧部分城市，当保护成本相对于潜在损失较小时，基于物理模型的综合预报系统高分辨率模式（IFS HRES）因其更高灵敏度而更适用；而当保护成本较高时，数据驱动的人工智能预报系统（AIFS）因其更高特异性而表现更优。这些发现强调了在现实风险情景下评估经济价值的重要性，以确保预报精度的提升转化为有意义的社会经济效益。
title: Assessing The Real-World Economic Value of Weather Forecasts under Compounding Extremes : A Decision-Specific Framework
title_zh: 复合极端事件下天气预报实际经济价值的评估：一个决策特定框架

abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies—and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'—the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其中的锚定地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在设定世界价格时所承载的权重。关税会降低商品侧的有效规模；资本管制则在金融侧产生相同效果。一个统一的结论由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深度融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们运用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三种欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩张、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响极为重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动能够重新引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本高达数千亿美元。

title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order

abstract: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. Mokyr's work explains why sustained growth was historically rare: prosperity required societies capable of generating, diffusing, and applying useful knowledge. The theory of creative destruction established by Aghion and Howitt explains why economic progress is inherently disruptive, as new technologies continuously replace older technologies, firms, and rents. In this paper, I argue that these ideas moved innovation from the periphery to the center of growth economics and recast growth theory as a dynamic process driven by experimentation, rivalry, entry, and reallocation. Recent research has extended these insights in numerous directions, including heterogeneous firms, business dynamism, talent allocation, artificial intelligence, and green innovation. I conclude by arguing that the central challenge of modern growth policy is not simply to accelerate innovation, but to sustain institutions that keep economies open to creative destruction while preserving competition, broad opportunity, and political support for technological change.
abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍伊特，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。莫基尔的研究解释了为何持续增长在历史上极为罕见：繁荣需要社会具备生成、传播和应用有用知识的能力。阿吉翁与霍伊特建立的创造性破坏理论则阐明，经济进步本质上具有颠覆性，因为新技术不断取代旧技术、旧企业和旧租金。本文认为，这些思想将创新从增长经济学的边缘推向核心，并将增长理论重塑为由实验、竞争、进入和重新配置驱动的动态过程。近期研究已将这些洞见拓展至多个方向，包括异质性企业、商业活力、人才配置、人工智能和绿色创新。最后，本文指出现代增长政策的核心挑战并非简单加速创新，而是维持那些使经济对创造性破坏保持开放的制度，同时保护竞争、广泛机遇以及技术变革的政治支持。
title: Creative destruction in economic growth
title_zh: 经济增长中的创造性破坏

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of informal competition—defined as competition faced by formal firms from informal enterprises—on the firm-provided worker training among formal manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises. Using a representative dataset of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms in 23 Sub-Saharan African countries, a sizable negative impact is found. A one-standard-deviation increase in informal competition reduces the probability that a firm offers training to its workers by 8.7 to 12.9 percentage points, relative to the sample mean of firms that offer training of approximately 25 percent. Comparable declines are observed in the share of workers receiving training. To address potential endogeneity, the paper employs several complementary strategies. First, an instrumental-variables strategy leverages variation in the number of children aged 0–4 and 5–9 years per working-age woman to generate exogenous shifts in informal competition. Second, heterogeneity is examined through tests derived from the “legalist” view of informality, which predicts bigger adverse effects of informal competition in environments characterized by a weaker rule of law and more stringent business regulations. Third, information about firms in other world regions is used to construct out-of-sample predictions of informal competition at the sector level. The findings sugge st that informal competition is a substantial constraint on the training investments of formal firms, underscoring the need for policy responses that mitigate its adverse consequences.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业提供员工培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量策略，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。
title: Does Informal Competition Reduce Firm-Provided Worker Training among Formal Manufacturing SMEs in Sub-Saharan Africa ?
title_zh: 非正式竞争是否减少了撒哈拉以南非洲正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训？

abstract: En este trabajo incorporamos al análisis teórico clásico de Calvo y Végh (1990,1991) y Végh (1992) sobre planes de estabilización de alta inflación basados en el tipo de cambio, el rol de la política fiscal, entendida como la dinámica del gasto público y la implementación de una reforma impositiva, así como también el rol de las devaluaciones nominales. Encontramos que las dinámicas de la inflación, el tipo de cambio real y la actividad son mucho más diversas y complejas, aun en el caso de perfecta credibilidad, que en los modelos originales. En relación a las estabilizaciones con credibilidad imperfecta, podemos matizar la expansión en el producto que sugieren estudios como el de Kiguel y Liviatan (1992) y establecer condiciones bajo las cuales dicha expansión se atenúa o incluso puede llegar a desaparecer. Finalmente, si bien todos nuestros hallazgos son teóricos, estos traen consigo implicancias empíricas susceptibles de ser contrastadas en futuras investigaciones.
abstract_zh: 本文在Calvo和Végh（1990,1991）以及Végh（1992）关于基于汇率的高通胀稳定计划的经典理论分析框架中，引入了财政政策的作用——即公共支出动态与税收改革实施，以及名义贬值的影响。研究发现，即使在完全可信的情况下，通胀、实际汇率和经济活动的动态变化也比原始模型更为多样和复杂。关于不完全可信的稳定计划，我们能够对Kiguel和Liviatan（1992）等研究提出的产出扩张观点进行细化，并确定该扩张减弱甚至可能消失的条件。最后，尽管所有发现均为理论性的，但它们蕴含了可在未来研究中检验的实证含义。
title: El rol de la política fiscal y de las devaluaciones nominales en las estabilizaciones basadas en el tipo de cambio
title_zh: 财政政策与名义贬值在基于汇率的稳定化中的作用

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of migrant inflows due to forced displacement events on the social capital in the recipient societies. We exploit the setting of Partition of India. Using data from districts in post 1947 India belonging to six states that saw a higher inflow of migrants, relative to outflow, we analyse how the â€˜shock' inflow of migrants affected social capital in the districts sixty years later. The shock is measured as the proportion of "displacedâ€ migrants in Indian districts in 1951 from census data. Survey data conducted in 2007 indicates that social capital is lower in districts that received more Partition migrants. The effect remains strongly robust to spatial robustness checks, contemporary differences in a host of demographic and public goods provision indicators. We find that these effects are mediated through riots, community conflicts and violent crime that start from Partition sixty years ago and continue through to more recent times. We also find that political participation, a proxy for social capital, falls over time in districts which see a relatively larger flow of displaced migrants. Our study contributes to the understanding of the long run implications of large forced displacement events.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了因被迫迁移事件导致的移民流入对接收地社会资本的影响。我们以印度分治为背景，利用1947年后印度六个移民净流入较高地区的县级数据，分析了六十年前移民的“冲击性”流入如何影响这些地区的社会资本。基于1951年人口普查数据，我们将冲击量化为印度各县“流离失所”移民的比例。2007年的调查数据显示，接收更多分治移民的县社会资本水平较低。这一效应在空间稳健性检验以及当代人口与公共品供给指标差异的控制下依然显著。研究发现，这些影响通过分治时期开始并延续至今的骚乱、社区冲突和暴力犯罪等中介机制发挥作用。此外，在流离失所移民流入相对较多的县，政治参与度（社会资本的代理变量）随时间推移而下降。本研究有助于理解大规模被迫迁移事件的长期影响。
title: Forced Displacement and Social Capital in the Long Run: Lessons from the Indian Partition
title_zh: 长期被迫流离失所与社会资本：印度分治的教训

abstract: Can violence erase an ethnic identity? We study this question using the Shining Path insurgency in Peru (1980-1992), which sought to replace competing affiliations with a single class identity and killed roughly 70,000 people, three-quarters of them Indigenous. Combining individual-level data on self-identification and mother tongue with event-level data on Shining Path violence, we implement a difference-in-differences design that exploits variation in exposure across cohorts at different stages of identity formation, within a matched border sample of pre-conflict comparable districts. Individuals exposed during their formative years (ages 0-19) are substantially less likely to identify as Indigenous or to speak an Indigenous language than cohorts whose identity was already formed when violence arrived. The effect is concentrated mostly in early childhood and particularly pronounced for mother tongue; the margin most directly shaped by parental transmission. Violence against non-Indigenous victims has no comparable effect. The mechanism is intra-group violence: because perpetrators were overwhelmingly co-ethnics from the same villages, visible Indigenous identity offered no protection and imposed costs. Consistent with this, the effect is strongest in Indigenous-homogeneous districts.
abstract_zh: 暴力能否抹去族群认同？我们以秘鲁"光辉道路"叛乱（1980-1992年）为研究对象，该组织试图以单一阶级认同取代其他身份认同，造成约7万人死亡，其中四分之三为原住民。通过将个体层面的自我认同与母语数据同"光辉道路"暴力事件数据相结合，我们采用双重差分法，利用冲突前可比地区匹配边界样本中不同身份形成阶段队列的暴露差异进行分析。结果表明，在身份形成期（0-19岁）暴露于暴力的个体，其认同为原住民或使用原住民语言的可能性显著低于暴力发生时身份已固化的队列。该效应主要集中在幼儿期，对母语的影响尤为突出——这一维度最直接受父母代际传递影响。针对非原住民受害者的暴力未产生类似效应。其机制在于群体内部暴力：由于施暴者绝大多数来自同村落的同族群体，显性的原住民身份既无法提供保护反而招致代价。与此一致的是，该效应在原住民聚居区最为显著。
title: Violence and ethnic identity
title_zh: 暴力与族群认同

abstract: Youth employment remains a critical issue in Sub-Saharan Africa. This study examines the impact of two large-scale governmental programmes in Cameroon and Madagascar that aim to promote self-employment in agriculture. Youth participated in vocational training and received technical support, inputs and mentoring to engage in crop, livestock or non-farming agricultural activities. We employ a quasi-experimental design to estimate the impact on the income of youth-led activities, and we address the limitations associated with such designs by carefully constructing a counterfactual. Our findings indicate that these integrated training and livelihoods programmes significantly enhance income from the targeted activities. We highlight the importance of providing regular support for participants during and after programme implementation.
abstract_zh: 青年就业仍是撒哈拉以南非洲地区的关键问题。本研究考察了喀麦隆和马达加斯加两项旨在促进农业领域自主创业的大型政府项目的影响。青年参与职业培训，并获得技术支持、物资投入和指导，从事作物种植、畜牧养殖或非耕作类农业活动。我们采用准实验设计来评估这些项目对青年主导活动收入的影响，并通过谨慎构建反事实框架来应对此类设计固有的局限性。研究结果表明，这些综合性的培训与生计项目显著提升了目标活动的收入水平。我们强调在项目实施期间及结束后为参与者提供持续支持的重要性。
title: From Training to Self-Employment: Evidence from Youth Agricultural Programmes in Cameroon and Madagascar
title_zh: 从培训到自雇：喀麦隆和马达加斯加青年农业项目的证据

abstract: On 28 January 2025 the second Trump administration issued a blanket stop-work order on the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), terminating the largest national bilateral aid programme worldwide. We use this natural experiment to estimate the impact of the aid cut on two outcomes in Africa: local economic activity, measured through nighttime light radiance around USAID project sites; and acute food insecurity, measured through the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) at the subnational level. First, the cessation of USAID activities produced a sharp and significant decline in nighttime light radiance within 500 m to 10 km of project sites, attenuating monotonically and undetectable at 25 km. Second, areas more exposed to USAID humanitarian assistance saw relative increases in population in IPC Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse and Phase 4 (Emergency), with effects building over the first post-shock year, amplified in higher-vulnerability regions and approximately fourteen times larger in less democratic countries. Third, both effects are driven by humanitarian-aid cuts; the nightlight effect is also driven by productive-sector cuts.
abstract_zh: 2025年1月28日，第二届特朗普政府发布全面停工令，叫停美国国际开发署（USAID）的所有工作，终止了全球规模最大的双边援助项目。我们利用这一自然实验，评估援助削减对非洲两项结果的影响：一是以USAID项目点周边夜间灯光亮度衡量的地方经济活动；二是以次国家级综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）衡量的严重粮食不安全状况。首先，USAID活动的停止导致项目点周边500米至10公里范围内夜间灯光亮度急剧且显著下降，该效应随距离单调衰减，至25公里处已无法检测。其次，在更依赖USAID人道主义援助的地区，处于IPC第三阶段（危机）或更糟阶段以及第四阶段（紧急）的人口比例相对上升，该效应在冲击后第一年内持续累积，在高脆弱性地区被放大，且在民主程度较低的国家中约高出十四倍。第三，上述两种效应均由人道主义援助削减驱动；夜间灯光效应还受到生产部门援助削减的影响。
title: The Economic Impact of the USAID Shutdown
title_zh: 美国国际开发署关闭的经济影响

abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, women constitute the majority of new Christian membership (including Evangelical and Pentecostal denominations), and this gender gap exceeds that of any other religion. Existing explanations for conversion to these churches emphasize demand for mutual help or informal insurance. We instead show that emancipation is central: these churches provide services that support women's economic advancement and help them challenge patriarchal norms. Using experimental data from Benin, we find that women randomly offered an economic opportunity become more likely to convert, partly because these churches help counter witchcraft threats, a risk that disproportionately targets economically successful women. To assess external validity, we combine large African datasets with local variation in exposure to positive economic shocks - using exogenous changes in cash crop prices and the implementation of world bank projects with a gender focus. Women are more likely to join new Christian churches following such shocks, especially where witchcraft beliefs are widespread. There, women work more, have fewer children, and exercise greater decisionâ€‘making power, while both women and men reject traditional beliefs, rituals, and authorities.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性构成了新兴基督教教会（包括福音派和五旬节派）新信徒的主体，这一性别差距超过任何其他宗教。现有对改信这些教会的解释强调对互助或非正式保险的需求。然而，我们证明解放是核心因素：这些教会提供支持女性经济进步并帮助她们挑战父权规范的服务。利用贝宁的实验数据，我们发现，随机获得经济机会的女性更可能改信，部分原因在于这些教会帮助对抗巫术威胁——这种风险不成比例地针对经济成功的女性。为评估外部有效性，我们将大型非洲数据集与正向经济冲击的局部暴露变化相结合——利用经济作物价格的外生变化以及以性别为重点的世界银行项目的实施。女性在经历此类冲击后更可能加入新兴基督教教会，尤其是在巫术信仰普遍的地区。在那里，女性工作更多、生育更少、拥有更大的决策权，同时女性和男性都摒弃传统信仰、仪式和权威。
title: Shaking the Traditional Order: Women's Conversion to New Christian Churches in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撼动传统秩序：撒哈拉以南非洲女性皈依新基督教教会研究

abstract: Literacy and numeracy unarguably are at the heart of human and economic development and, as a result, have received widespread attention in recent decades. Yet, there are still issues related to the effective strategies of creating such basic skills. In this paper, I show how a free compulsory universal basic education (FCUBE) policy in Ghana helped improve skills attainment. I employ a difference-in-differences strategy to assess the long-term causal impact of FCUBE using the Ghana Living Standard Survey 2012-2017. Overall, I find that FCUBE increased literacy and numeracy by 4.6 and 3.0 p.p respectively, but had a larger effect for urban and less disadvantaged students, thereby exacerbating inequality in skills attainment. Additionally, my results show that only the lower secondary education, and not primary education, was sufficient to guarantee skills attainment.
abstract_zh: 毋庸置疑，识字与算术能力是人类与经济发展的核心，因此近几十年来受到广泛关注。然而，如何有效培养这些基本技能仍存在诸多问题。本文展示了加纳免费义务普及基础教育政策如何促进技能提升。我采用双重差分法，利用2012-2017年加纳生活水平调查数据，评估该政策的长期因果效应。总体而言，研究发现该政策使识字率与算术能力分别提升4.6和3.0个百分点，但对城市及弱势程度较低的学生影响更大，从而加剧了技能获取的不平等。此外，研究结果表明，仅初中教育而非小学教育足以保障技能习得。

abstract: We describe a quantum variational algorithm for securities transactions settlement optimization, based on a novel mathematical formalization of the problem that includes the most relevant constraints considered in the pan-European securities settlement platform TARGET2-Securities. The proposed algorithm is designed for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices, specifically targeting IBM's superconducting qubit machines. We adopt non-linear activation functions to encode inequality constraints in the objective function of the problem, and design customized noise mitigation techniques to alleviate the effect of readout errors. We consider batches of up to 40 trades obtained from real transactional data to benchmark our algorithm on quantum hardware against classical and quantum-inspired solvers.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种用于证券交易结算优化的量子变分算法，该算法基于问题的一种新颖数学形式化，包含了泛欧证券结算平台TARGET2-Securities中考虑的最相关约束条件。所提出的算法专为噪声中等规模量子设备设计，特别针对IBM的超导量子比特机器。我们采用非线性激活函数将不等式约束编码到问题的目标函数中，并设计定制化的噪声缓解技术以减轻读出误差的影响。我们利用从真实交易数据中获取的至多40笔交易的批次，在量子硬件上对我们的算法与经典及量子启发式求解器进行了基准测试。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Securities transaction settlement optimization on superconducting quantum devices
title_zh: 超导量子设备上的证券交易结算优化

abstract: Mean grocery spending by Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) households peaks at benefit receipt and declines thereafter. Using novel shopping receipt data with observed trip-level tender information across a range of retailers, store formats, and shopping channels, we examine whether households partially smooth grocery spending over the benefit cycle through substitution across payment sources and whether the effects of benefit receipt vary across the grocery spending distribution. We find evidence of smoothing at the extensive margin through modest increases in non-SNAP-funded shopping trips. Distributional analyses reveal more pronounced spending cycles at higher grocery spending quantiles along with suggestive evidence of weaker substitution toward non-SNAP-funded payment sources.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）家庭的平均食品杂货支出在福利发放时达到峰值，随后逐渐下降。利用涵盖多种零售商、门店业态及购物渠道的新型购物收据数据（包含单次行程的支付方式信息），我们考察了家庭是否通过跨支付来源的替代行为部分平滑福利周期内的食品杂货支出，以及福利发放效应是否随食品杂货支出分布而变化。研究发现，家庭通过适度增加非SNAP资助的购物行程，在集约边际上实现了支出平滑。分布分析表明，更高食品杂货支出分位点上的支出周期更为显著，同时存在非SNAP资助支付来源替代效应减弱的暗示性证据。
title: The SNAP benefit cycle beyond the mean: Substitution across payment sources and distributional heterogeneity
title_zh: 均值之外的SNAP福利周期：支付来源的替代与分布异质性

abstract: We study the relationship between interpersonal trust and political stability in democratic countries. Using an annual country-level panel dataset covering six decades, we find that recessions are more likely to cause political turnover in countries with lower levels of generalised interpersonal trust. The effect is present in democracies and not autocracies, for turnovers occurring through regular procedures and not coups, and during regularly scheduled election years. We find an analogous connection between trust and leader turnover during recessions when looking across sub-national regions in Europe, across counties in the United States, and across individuals in U.S. counties. Our results highlight the crucial role of generalised trust in ensuring political stability during times of economic turmoil.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究民主国家中人际信任与政治稳定性之间的关系。利用覆盖六十年的年度国家层面面板数据集，我们发现，在普遍人际信任水平较低的国家，经济衰退更易引发政治更迭。这一效应存在于民主国家而非专制国家，体现在通过常规程序而非政变实现的更迭中，且集中于定期选举年份。通过考察欧洲次国家区域、美国各县以及美国各县个体层面的数据，我们同样发现经济衰退期间信任与领导人更迭之间存在类似关联。研究结果凸显了普遍信任在经济动荡时期确保政治稳定性的关键作用。
title: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
title_zh: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定

abstract: I show that the overreaction of the long-term yield forecasts to yield news, evidenced in recent studies, results directly from the overreaction of long-horizon inflation forecasts to inflation news. Motivated by this finding, I study how agents form inflation expectations across forecast horizons. Short-horizon survey forecasts underreact, while long-horizon forecasts overreact to inflation news. To reconcile this behavior, I implement a long-run bias, building on the widely shared intuition that agents conflate transitory with permanent shocks, within a realistic trend-gap inflation model. I embed this bias within a yield curve model. The long-horizon inflation expectations overreaction translates into a long-term yields’ overreaction, generating excess yield sensitivity to news. The model implies a long-term bond risk premium substantially less volatile and cyclical than that implied by predictive regressions or estimates imposing full-information rational expectations.
abstract_zh: 我证明，近期研究中发现的长期收益率预测对收益率消息的过度反应，直接源于长期通胀预测对通胀消息的过度反应。基于这一发现，我研究了经济主体在不同预测期限上如何形成通胀预期。短期调查预测对通胀消息反应不足，而长期预测则反应过度。为调和这一行为，我在一个现实的趋势-缺口通胀模型中引入长期偏差，基于广泛认同的直觉，即经济主体将暂时性冲击与永久性冲击混淆。我将这一偏差嵌入收益率曲线模型。长期通胀预期的过度反应转化为长期收益率的过度反应，产生收益率对消息的过度敏感性。该模型意味着长期债券风险溢价的波动性和周期性显著低于预测回归或强加完全信息理性预期估计所隐含的水平。
title: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
title_zh: 跨期限预测偏差：通胀预期与国债收益率

abstract: The modal factor model represents a novel statistical framework for dimension reduction in high dimensional panel data analysis. It is specifically designed to capture modal factors which exert a significant influence on the conditional mode of the distribution of the observables. Statistical inference for this model is developed based on a newly proposed modal component analysis, where modal factors and their corresponding loadings are estimated through maximizing a kernel-type objective function. Two computationally efficient and easy-to-implement algorithms—minorization-maximization and alternating maximization—are devised for the numerical computation of these estimators. Furthermore, two model selection criteria are proposed to determine the optimal number of modal factors. Under mild regularity conditions that accommodate both cross-sectional and time-series dependence, the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established. Additionally, the limiting distributions of parameter estimators and forecasts derived from factor-augmented regressions incorporating estimated modal factors are rigorously derived. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed estimators exhibit favorable finite-sample performance, even in the presence of heavy-tailed, skewed, multimodal, and heteroskedastic error distributions. Finally, an application to inflation and industrial production index forecasting validates the practical merits and superior predictive power of modal factors in real-world macroeconomic scenarios.
abstract_zh: 模态因子模型代表了一种新颖的统计框架，用于高维面板数据分析中的降维处理。它专门设计用于捕捉对观测变量分布条件众数具有显著影响的模态因子。基于新提出的模态成分分析，该模型的统计推断得以发展，其中模态因子及其相应的载荷通过最大化核型目标函数来估计。为了这些估计量的数值计算，设计了两种计算高效且易于实现的算法——最小化-最大化算法和交替最大化算法。此外，提出了两种模型选择准则以确定最优模态因子数量。在适应横截面和时间序列依赖性的温和正则条件下，建立了所提估计量的渐近性质。同时，严格推导了包含估计模态因子的因子增强回归中参数估计量及预测的极限分布。模拟研究表明，即使在存在重尾、偏斜、多峰及异方差误差分布的情况下，所提估计量也展现出良好的有限样本性能。最后，应用于通货膨胀和工业生产指数预测的实例验证了模态因子在现实宏观经济情景中的实用价值及优越的预测能力。
title: MCA: High-dimensional modal component analysis towards the mode
title_zh: MCA：面向模态的高维模态成分分析

abstract: Recent empirical evidence suggesting the malleability of identity raises the critical question of whether an updated identity, adapted to new environments, endures and under what conditions. To address this question, I analyze the 2009 parliamentary election in Malawi, during which the results deviated from historical voting patterns along ethno-regional lines. Specifically, the southern-based Democratic Progressive Party unexpectedly gained overwhelming support across the country, reducing the salience of local ethnic groups and signaling a drive for unity among historically divided societies. By comparing constituencies where this party barely won or lost, I find that the victory significantly reduced citizens’ sense of ethnic instead of national identity—particularly in rural areas historically aligned with opposition parties. This effect persisted for several years, coinciding with improvements in certain public goods and services, but dissipated within seven years. Furthermore, there is no evidence that selective migration across ethnic homelands, strategic downplaying of ethnic attachments, or post-election disillusionment with the party explains the identity shift, though these alternatives cannot be conclusively dismissed. These findings suggest that while identity can swiftly respond to socioeconomic shocks that alter group salience, it may revert to its original state unless further shocks or policies reinforce the altered identity.
abstract_zh: 近期实证证据表明身份认同具有可塑性，这引发了一个关键问题：适应新环境而更新的身份认同是否能够持久，以及在何种条件下得以持久。为解答此问题，我分析了2009年马拉维议会选举，此次选举结果偏离了历史上沿族群-地域界限的投票模式。具体而言，以南地区为根据地的民主进步党意外在全国范围内获得压倒性支持，削弱了地方族群的重要性，并标志着历史上分裂社会走向团结的驱动力。通过比较该党以微弱优势获胜或落败的选区，我发现该党的胜利显著降低了公民的族群认同感，而非国家认同感——尤其是在历史上与反对党结盟的农村地区。这一效应持续了数年，与某些公共产品和服务改善的时间相吻合，但在七年内逐渐消退。此外，没有证据表明选择性迁往族群故土、策略性淡化族群依附或选后对该党的失望情绪能解释这一身份转变，尽管这些替代解释无法被完全排除。这些发现表明，尽管身份认同能够迅速响应改变群体显著性的社会经济冲击，但除非有进一步的冲击或政策强化已改变的身份认同，否则它可能回归原初状态。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: On the persistence of fluid identity: Insights from the decline of ethnic voting in Malawi
title_zh: 论流动身份的持续性：来自马拉维族群投票衰落的启示

abstract: To investigate the heterogeneous impacts of test-optional policies, I construct a network of private colleges based on their self-reported peer institutions and detect communities within it using a network science algorithm. I then estimate treatment effects by comparing adopters and non-adopters within the same community. I show how restricting to within-community comparisons drastically attenuates the severe pre-trends that arise when all untreated units serve as controls, suggesting that, within community, a parallel counterfactual trends assumption is satisfied. Overall, adoption substantially increases reported SAT scores, making adopting schools appear more selective, but decreases the share of bachelor’s degree completions in STEM, suggesting that marginally enrolled students are much less likely to complete a STEM degree than those they have displaced. Effects vary by community; at the most selective liberal arts colleges, policy adoption causes an 8 (26) percent decline in the share of all (under-represented minority) bachelor’s completions with a STEM major.
abstract_zh: 为探究选择性考试政策（test-optional）的异质性影响，我基于私立学院自我报告的同行院校构建了一个网络，并运用网络科学算法识别其中的社群。随后，我通过比较同一社群内的采纳者与非采纳者来估计处理效应。我展示了将比较限制在社群内部如何大幅减弱当所有未处理单位作为对照组时出现的严重预趋势，这表明在社群内部，平行反事实趋势假设得以满足。总体而言，政策采纳显著提高了报告的SAT分数，使采纳学校显得更具选择性，但降低了STEM领域学士学位完成比例，这表明边际入学学生完成STEM学位的可能性远低于他们所取代的学生。效应因社群而异；在最具选择性的文理学院中，政策采纳导致STEM专业学士学位完成比例总体下降8%，少数族裔群体下降26%。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
title_zh: 同行院校网络、可选考试录取政策与STEM专业完成率

abstract: This paper studies the impact of the order of senders in a sequential Bayesian persuasion game on the receiver’s equilibrium utility. We find that it is always optimal for the receiver to put the more aligned sender before the less aligned sender. Comparative statics analysis shows that when we restrict to senders who are comparable (i.e., a sender is more aligned than the other sender), as the degree of misalignment between senders increases or as the number of senders increases, the receiver’s equilibrium utility may (weakly) decrease. In addition, we find that when senders are comparable, the sequential game performs no worse than the simultaneous game in terms of information disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了序贯贝叶斯说服博弈中发送者顺序对接收者均衡效用的影响。我们发现，将更契合的发送者置于较不契合的发送者之前，对接收者而言总是最优的。比较静态分析表明，当限制在可比较的发送者之间（即一个发送者比另一个更契合）时，随着发送者间不契合程度的增加或发送者数量的增加，接收者的均衡效用可能（弱）下降。此外，我们发现当发送者可比较时，序贯博弈在信息披露方面不劣于同时博弈。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Optimal sender ordering in sequential persuasion
title_zh: 序列说服中的最优发送者排序

abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能显著减轻体重，并可能改变社会与经济结果。利用《理解美国研究》数据，我将因减重而开始使用GLP-1的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的婚姻/同居率上升29个百分点，基线未就业女性的就业率上升27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未瓦解，而已就业女性未表现出向上职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的部分作用机制在于新匹配关系的形成，而非仅通过健康或现有生产力途径实现。
title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚

abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性。这类基金近年来迅速扩张，目前管理资产规模已超过3000亿美元。这些基金通过持有远多于传统贷款共同基金的流动性较差的贷款来实现流动性转换，同时允许投资者通过季度回购要约（通常上限为流通份额的5%）按资产净值赎回。我们证明，现金缓冲和合同约定的贷款偿还不足以应对持续5%的季度赎回；资金流入恰恰在流出上升时减少；净流出通过出售流动性较差的贷款、外部借款以及通过应付回购延迟支付来应对。因此，战略互补性出现，因为赎回对剩余投资者施加了清算和杠杆成本。我们表明，贷款清算、杠杆增加和资产净值膨胀在当前类似挤兑的赎回事件放大中发挥了重要作用。总体而言，我们的证据表明，季度赎回门槛和赎回上限并未消除半流动性私募信贷基金中类似挤兑的脆弱性，这为扩大零售投资者进入私募信贷市场敲响了警钟。
title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
title_zh: 半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性

abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an “invisible hand” determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic model in which both prices and quantities are chosen optimally by firms and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. As a consequence, individual markets will generically be in Walrasian disequilibrium: either slack (over-supplied) or rationed (under-supplied). The absence of market clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are governed by the probability of rationing rather than the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. Marrying the Old and New Keynesian traditions, we study general Walrasian disequilibrium with rational expectations and optimal firm decisions. On a technical level, we characterize cross-market spillovers arising from rationed demand with differentiated goods, overcoming the standard combinatorial problem that arises when studying multi-market disequilibrium. Unlike in New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing product-market slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption with muted effects on employment, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks.
abstract_zh: 现代商业周期理论不允许同时理性选择价格和数量，而是假设“看不见的手”决定其中一个变量以出清市场。本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，其中价格和数量均由企业最优选择，且交换既是自愿的也是有效的。因此，单个市场通常处于瓦尔拉斯非均衡状态：要么松弛（供给过剩），要么配给（供给不足）。市场非出清在本质上改变了定价与生产行为：加成率由配给概率而非需求弹性决定，更高的不确定性会减少产量并提高加成率。融合新旧凯恩斯主义传统，我们研究了具有理性预期和企业最优决策的一般瓦尔拉斯非均衡。在技术层面，我们刻画了差异化商品因配给需求产生的跨市场溢出效应，克服了研究多市场非均衡时面临的标准组合问题。与新凯恩斯主义经济不同，货币冲击通过减少产品市场松弛来传导，从而提高总劳动生产率和消费，但对就业影响有限；而不确定性冲击则表现为滞胀型成本推动冲击。
title: Pricing and Production Without the Invisible Hand
title_zh: 无形之手缺失下的定价与生产

abstract: We study how wealth inequality shapes safe-asset demand in heterogeneous-agent economies. Asset bubbles arise when agents face sufficiently high probabilities of falling into extreme poverty. In such cases, assets insulated from idiosyncratic risk become infinitely large relative to agents' wealth ex-post, which makes them infinitely valuable ex-ante. This mechanism is fundamentally different from classic rational bubbles, generates bubbles even under stationary wealth distributions, and requires no aggregate uncertainty or growth. Using this insight, we revisit the pricing of aggregate assets in standard heterogeneous-agent economies, and show that prior analyses may be incomplete due to overlooked possibility of transversality condition violation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究财富不平等如何塑造异质性主体经济体中的安全资产需求。当主体面临足够高的极端贫困概率时，资产泡沫便会形成。在此情形下，免受异质性风险影响的资产相对于主体事后财富而言变得无限大，从而使其事前价值趋于无穷。这一机制与经典理性泡沫存在本质差异，即便在稳态财富分布下也能产生泡沫，且无需依赖总体不确定性或经济增长。基于这一发现，我们重新审视标准异质性主体经济体中总体资产的定价问题，并指出由于横截条件可能被违反这一被忽视的可能性，先前的分析可能存在不完整性。
title: Wealth Inequality and Safe Asset Demand
title_zh: 财富不平等与安全资产需求

abstract: Road traffic injuries are the leading cause of death among people aged 5–29. Where traffic laws are weakly enforced, it is unclear whether road safety interventions can change behavior. We run a randomized controlled trial among 203 Kenyan minibuses, testing whether an incentive scheme improves safety overall or merely shifts unsafe driving to unmonitored times. Drivers reduce speeding by 29 percent and harsh braking by 13 percent, improving a safety index by 0.096 standard deviations. Labor-supply and earnings effects are modest, with little displacement across times or places. Improvements fade quickly, suggesting lasting change requires sustained enforcement or stronger incentives.
abstract_zh: 道路交通伤害是5至29岁人群的首要死因。在交通法规执行不力的地区，道路安全干预措施能否改变行为尚不明确。我们对203辆肯尼亚小巴开展了一项随机对照试验，检验激励计划是全面改善安全性，还是仅仅将危险驾驶行为转移至未受监控时段。驾驶员超速行为减少29%，急刹车减少13%，安全指数提升0.096个标准差。劳动力供给与收入效应较为温和，且未出现显著的时间或空间替代效应。但改善效果迅速消退，表明持久改变需要持续执法或更强激励。
title: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
title_zh: 价格换取更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据

abstract: This paper studies market design for generative AI intermediation. AI answer systems can improve user experience while diverting visits that finance publisher content and generate source-level quality signals. I show that an AI platform that underinternalizes future content reproduction retains too little referral traffic and can make costly open-web information subcritical, even with truthful content, accurate answers, and rational users. The mechanism can be self-reinforcing: less source-level measurement weakens conventional search, inducing further AI reliance. Sustainable repair requires replacing displaced revenue and deleted measurement through visitor-replacement royalties, audited provenance, human-information audits, and keystone-topic compensation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究生成式人工智能中介的市场设计。人工智能问答系统在改善用户体验的同时，会分流原本用于资助发布者内容并产生源级质量信号的访问流量。研究表明，若人工智能平台未能充分内化未来内容再生产的影响，其保留的推荐流量将过少，甚至可能使开放网络信息陷入临界不足状态——即便在内容真实、答案准确且用户理性的条件下也是如此。该机制可能形成自我强化：源级测量减少会削弱传统搜索功能，进而促使人工智能进一步被依赖。可持续修复需要借助访客替代版税、审计溯源、人工信息审计及关键主题补偿等手段，来弥补被替代的收入与被删除的测量数据。
title: AI and the Collapse of the www
title_zh: 人工智能与万维网的崩溃

abstract: We study the equilibrium effects of financial repression on government funding costs in an endowment economy with limited asset market participation. We show how a broad set of repression policies operates through a wedge in the Euler equation responsive to government size or by affecting fiscal redistribution between agents. Repression intensity is captured by a policy feedback rule that depends positively on net government spending. When fiscal policy is profligate and monetary policy accommodates, we show that such a repression policy raises bond values, reduces the inflationary cost of unfunded fiscal expansions, and lowers bond risk premia. Repression is not a free lunch for bondholders---they pay a lower inflation tax but also earn lower future real returns. When monetary policy does not accommodate fiscal policy, repression can provide stopgap funding for deficits, allowing the central bank to retain control over inflation while making government debt a hedge for fiscal inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限资产市场参与的禀赋经济中，金融抑制对政府融资成本的均衡效应。研究表明，一系列广泛的抑制政策通过影响欧拉方程中与政府规模相关的楔子，或通过改变主体间的财政再分配发挥作用。抑制强度由一项与净政府支出正相关的政策反馈规则来刻画。当财政政策挥霍无度且货币政策具有适应性时，此类抑制政策会提升债券价值，降低无资金支持的财政扩张的通胀成本，并压低债券风险溢价。抑制并非债券持有人的免费午餐——他们虽支付较低的通胀税，但未来实际回报率也更低。当货币政策不配合财政政策时，抑制可为赤字提供临时融资，使央行在保持通胀控制力的同时，让政府债务成为对冲财政通胀的工具。
title: Government Funding Costs Under Financial Repression
title_zh: 金融抑制下的政府融资成本

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are lowering the entry barriers to working with exciting data sources that used to require strong data science skills, such as handwritten ledgers, text, images, or sound recordings. This guide provides an introduction for researchers who are new to LLMs. It sets out a step-by-step workflow for turning a research idea into working code and data, and describes the four main ways of interacting with an LLM: the chat window, editor-integrated assistants, agentic coding tools, and the API. It then works through the decisions a practitioner meets in sequence, beginning with whether an LLM is the right tool and whether the data are allowed to be sent to one, then how to select models, write prompts, manage context limits, and control costs, and finally how to validate, reproduce, document, and correct LLM-generated measures in regression settings. A review of recent research shows how these tools already extract, link, harmonize, and classify historical data at scale. Four worked examples with replication files illustrate the use of LLMs. They classify emotions in paintings, link census records without names, measure newspaper salience and sentiment around the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, and score the emotional delivery of Franklin D. Roosevelt's wartime speeches. The guide also condenses the workflow, the best-practice recommendations, and the preparation of replication packages into summary tables and checklists to aid applied economists.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在降低处理以往需要较强数据科学技能（如手写账本、文本、图像或录音）的优质数据源的准入门槛。本指南为初涉LLM的研究者提供入门指导，系统阐述了将研究构想转化为可运行代码与数据的逐步工作流程，并介绍了与LLM交互的四种主要方式：聊天窗口、编辑器集成助手、自主编码工具及应用程序编程接口（API）。随后，指南按序梳理实践者需应对的决策环节：首先判断LLM是否为合适工具及数据是否允许传输至模型，继而探讨模型选择、提示词编写、上下文限制管理及成本控制策略，最后阐述如何在回归分析场景中验证、复现、记录并修正LLM生成的度量指标。近期研究综述表明，这些工具已能大规模实现历史数据的提取、关联、整合与分类。四个附有复现文件的实操案例展示了LLM的应用场景：对画作中的情感进行分类、无姓名关联人口普查记录、测量1882年《排华法案》相关报纸的显著性与情感倾向，以及评估富兰克林·D·罗斯福战时演讲的情感表达。本指南还将工作流程、最佳实践建议及复现包准备要点凝练为汇总表格与核查清单，以辅助应用经济学研究者。

abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.
abstract_zh: 父母可能会通过补偿处于劣势的孩子或强化预期回报更高的孩子，在不同子女间进行差异化投资。我们利用一项在个体学生层面随机分配转移支付的现金转移实验来研究这一问题，该实验在同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹间产生了外生的转移支付暴露差异。转移支付提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了负面溢出效应：受助学生的未受助兄弟姐妹大学毕业的可能性降低了3.7个百分点，相对于对照组均值下降了约30%。我们通过一个家庭学校教育决策的动态模型来解释这些效应，该模型识别出父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度。估计模型表明，父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度有限，并复现了未用于估计的保留样本中的处理效应。分解分析显示，负面溢出效应主要由教育投资向受助子女的替代效应驱动。
title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
title_zh: 补偿与强化：父母对子女不平等厌恶的实验识别

abstract: What information do policymakers need to design Pigouvian taxes or subsidies? Standard logic suggests that it is sufficient to know the size of the externality and unnecessary to know about quantities. Yet this logic is incorrect if interventions have fixed costs, taxes create deadweight losses, or there are distributional concerns. We present a model in which these considerations can make it more valuable for policymakers to learn about equilibrium quantities. We apply the model to congestion pricing, which has high fixed costs, and to a proposed housing subsidy in Boston that features deadweight losses and distributional concerns.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者设计庇古税或补贴时需要哪些信息？标准逻辑认为，只需了解外部性的大小，无需掌握数量信息。然而，若干预措施存在固定成本、税收产生无谓损失或涉及分配问题，这一逻辑便不再成立。我们构建了一个模型，表明在这些考量下，政策制定者了解均衡数量可能更具价值。我们将该模型应用于具有高固定成本的拥堵定价，以及波士顿一项涉及无谓损失和分配问题的拟议住房补贴。
title: Prices Versus Quantities Revisited: What Do Policymakers Need to Know to Set Pigouvian Taxes and Subsidies?
title_zh: 价格与数量再探讨：政策制定者设定庇古税与补贴需要了解什么？

abstract: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用于理解贸易及贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的实证证据及相关建模框架，特别关注劳动力市场摩擦与调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这表明劳动力市场中存在重要的调整摩擦，且这些影响随时间缓慢演变，意味着需要构建能够解释缓慢转型的动态框架。在梳理该领域关键见解后，本文探讨了旨在减轻工人成本、确保贸易收益更公平分配的政策措施。

abstract: We ask how far the choice of which moments to match can push estimates in misspecified structural models. The answer is: very far. Under regularity conditions, an adversarial researcher informed about the data distribution can choose moments that render any parameter value the unique solution to the population moment-matching problem. Moreover, in many cases they can do so with little increase in model-implied standard errors relative to maximum likelihood. We illustrate both results in a menu-cost model.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨在错误设定的结构模型中，选择匹配哪些矩条件能在多大程度上影响估计结果。答案是：影响极大。在正则条件下，一位了解数据分布信息的对抗性研究者可以选择矩条件，使得任何参数值都成为总体矩匹配问题的唯一解。此外，在许多情况下，他们这样做时，模型隐含的标准误相较于最大似然估计仅有微小增加。我们通过一个菜单成本模型对这两个结论进行了说明。
title: The Incredible Flexibility of Moment Matching
title_zh: 矩匹配的惊人灵活性

abstract: A large share of secular variation in real interest rates can be understood as the effect of monetary policy leaning against experience-based long-run inflation expectations. Survey microdata show that adaptive learning from experienced inflation generates highly persistent, slow-moving long-run inflation expectations. When expectations are shaped by experience, central banks cannot anchor them through communication. Instead, when expectations deviate from the inflation target, monetary policy must remain persistently hawkish or dovish to generate realized inflation outcomes that, through agents’ belief updating, gradually pull long-run expectations back toward the target. Consistent with this mechanism, I find a strong positive relationship between experience-based long-run inflation expectations and real interest rates in the U.S., Germany, the U.K., and Japan. Under their subjective expectations, private-sector agents do not anticipate future reversals in inflation and short-term real interest rates. As a result, long-term real interest rates move with experience-based long-run inflation expectations about as much as short-term real interest rates do, consistent with the data. Secular movements in real rates are also accompanied by persistent patterns in interest-rate forecast errors. Overall, the interaction of monetary policy and learning from experience generates a distinct source of secular real-rate variation, beyond movements in the natural rate of interest.
abstract_zh: 实际利率长期波动的很大一部分可以理解为货币政策对抗基于经验的长期通胀预期的影响。调查微观数据显示，基于经历通胀的自适应学习会产生高度持久、缓慢变动的长期通胀预期。当预期由经验塑造时，央行无法通过沟通来锚定这些预期。相反，当预期偏离通胀目标时，货币政策必须持续保持鹰派或鸽派立场，以产生实际通胀结果，通过经济主体的信念更新，逐步将长期预期拉回目标水平。与这一机制一致，我发现美国、德国、英国和日本的基于经验的长期通胀预期与实际利率之间存在强正相关关系。在其主观预期下，私营部门经济主体并未预期未来通胀和短期实际利率会出现逆转。因此，长期实际利率随基于经验的长期通胀预期变动的幅度与短期实际利率大致相同，这与数据一致。实际利率的长期波动还伴随着利率预测误差的持续性模式。总体而言，货币政策与经验学习的相互作用，在自然利率变动之外，产生了实际利率长期波动的独特来源。
title: Leaning Against Inflation Experiences
title_zh: 对抗通胀的经验

abstract: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.
abstract_zh: 医疗改革往往在实施前就已颁布，由此产生的不确定性会影响企业的决策。我们利用2000-2009年的机构层面数据，并借助D部分（Part D）对老年人口比例较高县的影响更为显著这一事实，考察了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业。与概念模型的预测一致——该模型认为实施前的不确定性抑制了市场进入，而实施后较低的利润率又阻碍了完全恢复——我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%相关，这主要是由于新店开业减少而非关店增加所致。我们还发现初步证据表明，药店可及性的降低削弱了D部分在降低死亡率方面的益处。
title: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
title_zh: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药房行业的证据

abstract: This paper studies migration and earnings dynamics in poor neighborhoods using new administrative data linking residential location and earnings. Out-migration rates are higher in poor neighborhoods than elsewhere, and the majority of people who leave a poor neighborhood move to a richer one. Residents of poor neighborhoods also see significant earnings mobility, with average growth rates similar to richer areas. Estimates based on idiosyncratic, firm-specific pay changes show that increases in earnings are linked to migration to better neighborhoods. This results in the earnings of the cohort who lived in a poor neighborhood at baseline growing more than twice as fast as the earnings of these neighborhoods' contemporaneous residents. Overall, our results highlight an underappreciated reason why poor neighborhoods stay poor: initial residents whose earnings grow tend to move away.
abstract_zh: 本文利用连接居住地与收入的新行政数据，研究贫困社区的迁移与收入动态。贫困社区的迁出率高于其他地区，且大多数离开贫困社区的人会迁往更富裕的社区。贫困社区居民的收入流动性也显著，其平均增长率与富裕地区相当。基于个体层面及企业特定薪酬变化的估计表明，收入增长与迁往更优社区存在关联。这导致基线期居住在贫困社区的群体收入增长速度，是同期仍居住在这些社区的居民收入增速的两倍以上。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了一个未被充分认识的贫困社区持续贫困的原因：收入增长的初始居民往往会迁离。
title: Dynamic Individuals, Static Neighborhoods: Migration and Earnings Changes in Poor Neighborhoods
title_zh: 动态个体，静态社区：贫困社区的迁移与收入变化

abstract: Real GDP per person is a widely used proxy for living standards, but it can be a poor welfare measure when new goods or quality improvements matter, when nonmarket goods are significant, and when preferences are nonhomothetic --- all of which are true in practice. We propose an alternative that is robust to these concerns: under weak conditions, the growth rate of the value of a statistical life (VSL), together with standard Euler-equation objects, identifies the growth rate of lifetime utility. The intuition is that people routinely trade off consumption against mortality risk, and their willingness to pay for small risk reductions reveals the value of remaining lifetime utility. Implementing this approach for the United States suggests that lifetime utility may have risen by more than a factor of five since 1940, whereas conventional consumption-based calculations using a stable log/CRRA flow utility imply much smaller gains, on the order of a doubling. This calculation is sensitive to measures of the growth rate of the VSL, the rate of time preference, and the interest rate. For example, if the correct interest rate is 4 percentage points higher than the T-bill rate, then lifetime utility would be measured to have declined by more than half since 1940.
abstract_zh: 人均实际GDP是衡量生活水平的常用指标，但当新商品或质量改进至关重要、非市场商品具有显著影响、且偏好非位似时（这些情况在实践中普遍存在），该指标可能成为糟糕的福利度量。我们提出一种对这些担忧具有稳健性的替代方案：在弱条件下，统计生命价值（VSL）的增长率与标准欧拉方程变量共同识别终身效用的增长率。其直觉在于，人们通常会在消费与死亡风险之间进行权衡，而其为微小风险降低所支付的意愿揭示了剩余终身效用的价值。将该方法应用于美国的数据表明，自1940年以来，终身效用可能增长了五倍以上，而基于稳定对数/CRRA流动效用的传统消费计算仅显示约两倍的增长。这一计算对VSL增长率、时间偏好率和利率的度量高度敏感。例如，若实际利率比国库券利率高4个百分点，则自1940年以来终身效用将被测算为下降超过一半。
title: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life
title_zh: 当GDP误导：从统计生命价值推断生活水平

abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜费用，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利通常包含较低的年度限额。本研究考察了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响——该群体视力损伤、患病率和残疾率均较高。基于2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据，采用双重差分法，我们估算出医疗补助常规视力福利使过去一年眼科检查率、眼镜购买量及医疗补助眼镜支出增加，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现存在向医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出的溢出效应证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使已享有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保人额外购买眼镜的现象一致，尽管估算结果较为温和。
title: When Medicaid Pays the Bill: Routine Vision Benefits, Eye Care Use, and Eyeglasses Spending Among Dual-eligible Medicare Enrollees
title_zh: 当医疗补助支付账单：双重资格医疗保险参保者的常规视力福利、眼科护理使用与眼镜支出

abstract: Focus We examine what happens when investors question fiscal sustainability and demand higher sovereign bond yields as compensation for higher risk. We call these episodes fiscal risk shocks. Such shocks can arise, for example, from a government announcing new spending or tax cuts, or from news that worsens its budget outlook. We develop a new method to identify these shocks from daily movements in bond yields. When fiscal concerns intensify, investors retreat from government bonds and shift towards the safest corporate bonds, resulting in negative co-movement in the yields of these bonds. Exploiting this relationship, we extract fiscal risk shocks for 12 economies. We then trace how these shocks propagate through exchange rates, equity markets, inflation and output.
abstract_zh: 焦点 本文研究当投资者质疑财政可持续性并要求更高的主权债券收益率以补偿更高风险时会发生什么。我们将此类事件称为财政风险冲击。例如，此类冲击可能源于政府宣布新增支出或减税，或源于恶化其预算前景的消息。我们开发了一种新方法，通过债券收益率的日常变动来识别这些冲击。当财政担忧加剧时，投资者会从政府债券中撤出，转向最安全的公司债券，导致这些债券收益率出现负向联动。利用这一关系，我们提取了12个经济体的财政风险冲击。随后，我们追踪这些冲击如何通过汇率、股票市场、通胀和产出进行传导。
title: Financial and real effects of fiscal risk
title_zh: 财政风险的金融与实际效应

abstract: Focus In standard models of monetary policy, public debt is assumed to have no role. Policy rate changes affect output and inflation through conventional channels, and any fiscal consequences of interest rate changes are assumed to be offset by corresponding adjustments in fiscal policy. However, with public debt high in many economies, this assumption may no longer be innocuous. Changes in monetary policy affect not only private borrowing costs but also government interest payments, the income earned by government bondholders and the market value of outstanding public debt. The impact depends on the size of the debt stock, which magnifies these effects, and the maturity profile, which determines how quickly higher policy rates pass through to debt service costs and interest income. It also depends on the sensitivity of bond values to changes in yields.
abstract_zh: 在标准货币政策模型中，公共债务通常被假定为不发挥作用。政策利率变动通过传统渠道影响产出和通胀，而利率变动的任何财政后果均被假定可通过财政政策的相应调整予以抵消。然而，鉴于许多经济体的公共债务水平高企，这一假设可能不再无关紧要。货币政策变动不仅影响私人借贷成本，还会影响政府利息支出、国债持有人获得的收入以及未偿公共债务的市场价值。其影响程度取决于债务存量规模（该规模会放大这些效应）以及期限结构（该结构决定政策利率上升在多大程度上传导至偿债成本和利息收入），同时还取决于债券价值对收益率变动的敏感度。
title: Public debt and monetary policy transmission: evidence from advanced and emerging Europe
title_zh: 公共债务与货币政策传导：来自发达与新兴欧洲的证据

abstract: This paper develops a framework to analyze partial population experiments, a generalization of the cluster experimental design where clusters are assigned to different treatment intensities. The framework allows for heterogeneity in cluster sizes and outcome distributions. The paper studies the large-sample behavior of OLS estimators and cluster-robust variance estimators and shows that (i) ignoring cluster heterogeneity may result in severely underpowered experiments and (ii) the cluster-robust variance estimator may be upward-biased when clusters are heterogeneous. The paper derives formulas for power, minimum detectable effects, and optimal cluster assignment probabilities. All the results apply to cluster experiments, a particular case of the framework. The paper sets up a potential outcomes framework to interpret the OLS estimands as causal effects. It implements the methods in a large-scale experiment to estimate the direct and spillover effects of a communication campaign on property tax compliance. The analysis reveals an increase in tax compliance among individuals directly targeted with the mailing, as well as compliance spillovers on untreated individuals in clusters with a high proportion of treated taxpayers.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析部分总体实验的框架，这是对聚类实验设计的一种推广，其中聚类被分配至不同的处理强度。该框架允许聚类规模与结果分布存在异质性。本文研究了OLS估计量及聚类稳健方差估计量的大样本性质，并表明：（i）忽略聚类异质性可能导致实验统计功效严重不足；（ii）当聚类存在异质性时，聚类稳健方差估计量可能存在向上偏误。本文推导了统计功效、最小可检测效应及最优聚类分配概率的公式。所有结论均适用于聚类实验（该框架的一个特例）。本文构建了一个潜在结果框架，将OLS估计量解释为因果效应。通过一项大规模实验实施该方法，用以估计通信宣传对财产税合规性的直接效应与溢出效应。分析显示，直接收到邮件的个体税收合规性有所提升，且在受处理纳税人比例较高的聚类中，未受处理的个体也出现了合规性溢出效应。
title: Design of Partial Population Experiments with an Application to Spillovers in Tax Compliance
title_zh: 部分总体实验设计及其在税收合规溢出效应中的应用

abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异幅度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能实现效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习规则可与现有资产定价模型中已实现收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进现有成果。若该基准达到饱和，将标志着理解资本市场如何处理企业层面信息的根本性突破。
title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
title_zh: 评估优化代理型人工智能系统对资产定价的益处

abstract: This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates. (JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1951年美联储-财政部协议前，初级预算盈余、意外通胀及钉住利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。研究发现，若保持初级预算平衡且避免因意外通胀及协议前利率钉住导致的实际利率扭曲，债务/GDP比率仅会从1946年的106%降至1974年的74%，而非实际历史中的23%。我们的结论表明，过去76年间，通过增长率超过未扭曲利率实现的债务削减规模极小。(JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
title: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
title_zh: 美国真的通过经济增长摆脱了二战债务吗？
